name: TukiFlow – Buy Now Button, Direct Checkout & One Page Checkout for WooCommerce
author: tukiDevs

sections.description:
TukiFlow takes the extra steps out of buying. A normal WooCommerce order goes product page → cart → checkout. With TukiFlow, shoppers skip the cart with a Buy Now button, or buy from a one page checkout landing page that shows the product and the checkout together.

Payment, shipping, tax and orders stay with WooCommerce. TukiFlow only removes the steps in between, so your gateways, shipping rules and order emails work as they do today. No page builder needed.

Skip the cart: direct checkout for WooCommerce

  • Buy Now button next to Add to cart. One click sends the shopper straight to checkout with the chosen size, color and quantity.
  • Skip cart for Add to cart too: turn on direct checkout so Add to cart goes straight to checkout, store-wide or for single products.
  • Keep the shopper’s cart, or empty it first so they check out with only this product.
  • Runs WooCommerce’s own add-to-cart checks, so stock limits and other plugins’ rules still apply.

Buy Now button on product pages and shop cards

  • Buy Now on single product pages and on shop, category and tag product cards, related products and product blocks.
  • Variable products on shop pages open the product with its options ready to pick.
  • Place it before or after Add to cart, and set your own button text.
  • Matches your theme out of the box, on classic and block themes. Or design it in Appearance → Customize → Buy Now with a live preview: presets, colors, hover colors, font, padding, corners and width, with separate designs for product pages and shop pages.

One page checkout landing pages for a single product

Put one product and the WooCommerce checkout on the same page, ready to link from ads, emails and social posts.

  • Create one in two steps: pick the product, then name the page. Or click Create landing page right from the product screen.
  • The page starts with the product photo and description above the checkout. Add your own text and images like any other page.
  • Sell variable products: shoppers pick size and color on the landing page.
  • Works on any page: turn on checkout in the page editor’s TukiFlow box, or use the [tukiflow] shortcode.
  • Find, filter, copy the link, duplicate or trash landing pages from one list.
  • Landing pages are never cached, so every shopper gets their own cart.

Coupons applied automatically

  • Pick a WooCommerce coupon for a landing page and it’s applied as soon as the shopper opens the page, if the cart qualifies.
  • The coupon is removed again when the shopper leaves the page, so the discount stays with that offer.
  • Checkout links (coming soon): copy a link (product + quantity + coupon) or a QR code to share on WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram or in print.

Sticky add to cart bar

  • A sticky Buy Now bar with the product name and price stays on screen after shoppers scroll past the product form.
  • Show it on phones only, or on phones and computers.
  • Uses the selected options and quantity, and follows your button design.

Different settings for every product

From the TukiFlow tab in the WooCommerce product editor:

  • Hide the Add to cart button for one product, or turn Buy Now off.
  • Change the Buy Now button text for one product (“Order now”, “Get yours”).
  • Set a starting quantity, for products sold in pairs or packs.
  • Skip the cart for one product only.

See what TukiFlow brings in

The TukiFlow Home screen shows the orders and revenue that came through Buy Now and landing pages in the last 30 days, plus a setup checklist for new stores and tips for running ones.

Built to stay out of the way

  • Works on stores that use the classic checkout or the Checkout block (landing pages always show WooCommerce’s classic checkout form), with any WooCommerce payment gateway (cash on delivery included) and High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
  • Scripts load only on pages where a button can appear.
  • No popups asking for reviews, no extra plugins installed.
  • Translation ready and right-to-left ready.
  • Choose whether TukiFlow’s settings are kept or removed when you delete the plugin. Your pages, products and orders are never deleted.

TukiFlow Pro

TukiFlow is complete on its own. TukiFlow Pro is a separate add-on for stores that want more from every order:

  • Landing pages with several products: shoppers tick what they want and change quantities on the page.
  • Order bump: offer one more product with a checkbox at checkout.
  • Page discounts: create a discount right from the landing page, and limit it to that page if you like.
  • Popup checkout: Buy Now opens the checkout in a popup or a side panel on the same page.
  • Recover unfinished checkouts: see shoppers who typed a phone number or email but didn’t order, reach them by call, WhatsApp or email with a link that refills their cart, create the order for them, and track recovered sales.
  • Sales reports: views, orders, revenue and conversion for every landing page and Buy Now button.
  • Quantity offers: “Buy 2, save 10%” cards on landing pages.
  • Short checkout: hide, rename and reorder checkout fields on a landing page, or use the Quick COD form with just name, phone and address.
  • Thank-you page offer (coming soon): a next-order coupon, or add a product to the same cash on delivery order in one tap.
  • Fake order protection: phone checks, repeat-order limits and a block list.

External services

TukiFlow uses the Freemius SDK (Freemius, Inc.) for an optional opt-in. Nothing is sent unless an administrator clicks “Allow & Continue” on the opt-in screen after activation; choosing “Skip” sends nothing, and TukiFlow works the same either way.

If you opt in, Freemius receives your name and email address, your site URL and title, your WordPress, PHP and plugin versions, your site language, and the list of installed plugins and themes. If you submit the optional feedback form when deactivating TukiFlow, your answer is sent too. You can opt out later from the TukiFlow row on the Plugins screen.

Freemius Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

Buy Now buttons, landing pages and checkout run entirely on your own site. TukiFlow sends no shopper or order data to any outside service.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins → Add New, search for “TukiFlow”, then install and activate it. WooCommerce must be installed and active.
  2. Open TukiFlow → Home. The setup checklist walks you through the first steps.
  3. Buy Now buttons are on by default. Change where they show, the button text and the cart behavior on TukiFlow → Buy Now.
  4. To change the button’s look, open Appearance → Customize → Buy Now.
  5. Go to TukiFlow → Landing pages to create a one page checkout landing page, or click Create landing page on any product.
sections.faq:
How do I skip the cart and go straight to checkout in WooCommerce?

Install TukiFlow. A Buy Now button appears next to Add to cart and takes shoppers straight to checkout. To make Add to cart skip the cart too, turn on direct checkout on TukiFlow → Buy Now, or for one product in its TukiFlow tab.

Is this a free one page checkout for WooCommerce?

Yes. TukiFlow’s landing pages put one product and the WooCommerce checkout on the same page, for free. Shoppers buy without visiting a product page or a cart. Several products on one page is part of TukiFlow Pro.

How do I add a Buy Now button to WooCommerce?

Install and activate TukiFlow. The Buy Now button shows on product pages and shop pages right away. Change its text, position and design on TukiFlow → Buy Now and in the Customizer.

How do I create a single product landing page with checkout?

Go to TukiFlow → Landing pages → Create landing page, pick the product, name the page and publish. Or click Create landing page on the product screen. The page shows the product photo and description above the checkout.

Can a coupon be applied automatically?

Yes. Pick a WooCommerce coupon for a landing page. It’s applied when the shopper arrives, as long as the cart meets the coupon’s rules, and removed when they leave the landing page.

Can I hide the Add to cart button or change its text for one product?

Yes. Open the product, go to the TukiFlow tab, and hide Add to cart, turn Buy Now off, or set your own Buy Now text for that product only.

Does Buy Now work with variable products and quantity?

Yes. The selected size, color and quantity go to checkout. On shop pages, Buy Now on a variable product opens the product so the shopper can pick options first.

Does it work with the Checkout block, my payment gateway and caching plugins?

Yes. Buy Now works with the classic checkout and the Checkout block, and with any WooCommerce payment gateway, including cash on delivery. Landing pages always show WooCommerce’s classic checkout form, even when your store’s checkout page uses the Checkout block. Landing pages tell caching plugins not to cache them. If your host caches pages at the server or CDN level, make sure it respects no-cache headers, or exclude your landing pages there.

Does TukiFlow replace the WooCommerce checkout?

No. TukiFlow prepares the cart and opens WooCommerce’s own checkout. Payment, shipping, tax and order creation stay with WooCommerce.

How is TukiFlow different from a funnel builder?

Funnel builders replace your checkout and usually need a page builder. TukiFlow keeps WooCommerce’s own checkout and works with the WordPress editor, so there’s less to set up and less that can clash with your other plugins.
sections.changelog:
1.4.2 (Nov 23, 2026)

  • Tweak: The TukiFlow menu keeps the screen you’re on in view when there are many screens.
  • Tweak: A landing page’s TukiFlow box lists the TukiFlow Pro quantity offers and checkout fields.

1.4.1 (Nov 22, 2026)

  • Fix: On landing pages, if a customer picks an option that isn’t available, they can no longer place an order for a different option by mistake.

1.4.0 (Nov 15, 2026)

  • New: Variable products on landing pages and [tukiflow] pages. Shoppers pick the option above the checkout and the order updates without reloading. Choose the option the page starts with when you create the page or in its TukiFlow box.
  • New: “Add to cart goes straight to checkout”, a store-wide switch on the Buy Now screen with a per-product override in the TukiFlow product tab. Off by default.
  • New: “Create landing page” button in the TukiFlow product tab and a “Create landing page” link in the Products list.
  • New: TukiFlow tags orders that came from Buy Now, a landing page or a [tukiflow] page, and Home shows “Orders from TukiFlow” for the last 30 days. Works with HPOS on and off.
  • New: TukiFlow Pro support: the plan in the TukiFlow header and Settings, an Analytics screen that previews the Pro report, and a few small, closable Pro mentions on TukiFlow screens.
  • Improved: A landing page set to one variation now lets shoppers switch to the product’s other options, starting on that variation.
  • Improved: The TukiFlow box in the page editor moved from the sidebar to a wider panel under the page content, with an on/off switch, Product and Coupon sections, and a summary of the chosen product (photo, price, stock). While checkout is off for a page, the panel loads nothing extra; turning it on shows the settings without reloading.
  • Improved: TukiFlow screens share one look: the same corners, switches, text boxes and save bar everywhere, with normal-case labels.
  • Improved: Shorter labels in the TukiFlow product tab (“Hide Buy Now”, “Hide Add to cart”, “Skip the cart”).
  • Improved: “Orders from TukiFlow” on Home counts orders by the day they were paid, or the day they were placed for cash on delivery orders that are still Processing.
  • Removed: The “Variable products aren’t supported on landing pages yet” note.

1.3.1 (Nov 6, 2026)

  • New: New landing pages start with the product photo and description above the checkout, and the editor shows a tip for finishing the page.
  • Improved: Pages that use the [tukiflow] shortcode now appear in the Landing pages list and on Home.
  • Improved: Turning on “Enable checkout on this page” adds the checkout block to the page if it’s missing.
  • Improved: New landing pages use a plain [tukiflow] shortcode. The product is set only in the page’s TukiFlow box, so there is one place to change it.
  • Improved: Turning on “Enable checkout on this page” on a page whose shortcode names a product keeps selling that product.
  • Improved: A landing page coupon is removed when the shopper leaves the landing page, so the discount doesn’t carry over to other purchases.
  • Improved: Landing pages added by an import or a site migration show up in the list right away.
  • Improved: US English spelling throughout (“color”).
  • Fixed: With “Match my theme” on block themes such as Twenty Twenty-Three, Buy Now now looks like the theme’s buttons instead of plain text, and lines up with Add to cart.
  • Fixed: On block themes, Buy Now on shop and related product cards sits next to Add to cart instead of on its own row, at the same size.
  • Fixed: With “Match my theme” on themes such as Astra, Buy Now is now the same size as Add to cart.
  • Fixed: On block themes, Buy Now moves under Add to cart in narrow product columns and on phones, instead of being squeezed or cut off.
  • Fixed: New and duplicated landing pages no longer show January 1, 1970 as their date.
  • Fixed: The “Please choose product options” message disappears as soon as the shopper picks a variation.
  • Removed: The Copy shortcode action in the Landing pages list. Use Copy link to share a landing page.

1.3.0 (Nov 2, 2026)

  • New: A fresh, easier TukiFlow dashboard with Home, Landing pages, Buy Now and Settings, plus a menu at the top of every TukiFlow page.
  • New: Home walks you through setup and points out things worth a look in your store.
  • New: Design the Buy Now button in Appearance > Customize and see the change on your real store as you edit. Product pages and shop pages can look different.
  • New: Ready-made button styles, plus a “Match my theme” option so Buy Now looks like your theme’s other buttons.
  • New: Choose the space between Buy Now and Add to cart, and set corners and inner spacing for each side.
  • New: Find, filter, copy, duplicate and delete your landing pages from one list.
  • New: Choose whether TukiFlow’s settings are kept or removed when you delete the plugin.
  • Improved: If you change Buy Now settings in two places at once, TukiFlow asks which version to keep.
  • Improved: The landing page product search shows only products that are live in your store.
  • Improved: If WooCommerce is turned off, you see one short note instead of an error on every page.
  • Improved: TukiFlow now needs WordPress 6.6 or newer.
  • Fixed: Caching plugins no longer save landing pages, so every shopper sees their own cart.
  • Fixed: Several Buy Now layout fixes on block themes, small screens and Storefront.
  • For developers: New hooks to extend landing pages, the Buy Now button and the TukiFlow dashboard.

1.2.4 (Oct 3, 2026)

  • Fixed: A landing page restored from the trash shows up in the TukiFlow list again.

1.2.3 (Sep 17, 2026)

  • New: Landing pages can add a WooCommerce coupon automatically.

1.2.2 (Sep 17, 2026)

  • New: An optional sticky Buy Now bar, on phones only or on all devices.

1.2.1 (Sep 15, 2026)

  • Improved: Buy Now only loads on pages where the button can appear, and landing pages focus on one product per page.
  • Fixed: Buy Now works on cached product pages and follows product rules set by WooCommerce and other plugins.

1.2.0 (Jul 10, 2026)

  • New: Checkout landing pages that use the normal WooCommerce checkout, per-product settings, and separate button styles for product and shop pages.

1.0.0

  • First release.
